notes: Seeded from an initial research pass (sources current to 2026-07-30). This file is the running dataset; the weekly workflow appends/updates entries and should avoid duplicating existing 'id' values. Aggregate 'as of' figures (e.g. IJ's tally, Georgia's count) should be treated as external trackers to check against, not summed with this list. Reconciled 2026-08-03 against a TechSpot summary of a WaPo investigation citing 'at least 50 officers nationally, 46 tied to Flock specifically': counting individual officers across cases[] (including bundled multi-officer entries) yields 48 total, 46 excluding the 2 entries already flagged as unconfirmed-Flock-vendor (Gordon-TN, Bryan-IL) - closely matching WaPo's figures, so no major gaps found. The one new lead from that piece (an unnamed GA police chief case) couldn't be turned into a case for lack of identifying detail; flagged instead as a note on the Steffman incident pending manual review.
